quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 215, 453, or 407?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the smaller one.
quests.explanation: Out of 215, 453, and 407, the number 215 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: Double 215 is 430! Because 215 + 215 = 430.

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "One Hundred Eighty-Eight" is how we say the number 188 in English, so 188 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 188, you get 189!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the tens place of 500?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the tens digit in 500.
quests.explanation: In 500, the digit 0 sits in the tens place!
quests.funFact: Zero means exactly nothing! If you have 0 apples, you have an empty basket.

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 251 or 268?
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 251 is smaller than 268 -- when counting up, 251 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 251 by 10, it becomes 2510!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 454, 309, or 405?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 454, 309, and 405, the number 454 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 454, it stays exactly the same: 454!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Say the word out loud, then look for the matching numeral among the choices.
quests.explanation: "Three Hundred Twenty-Six" is how we say the number 326 in English, so 326 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: The number 326 is an even number!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 377 or 332?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further left is smaller.
quests.explanation: 332 is smaller than 377 -- when counting up, 332 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 332 comes right after 331!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "Four Hundred Seventy-Six" is how we say the number 476 in English, so 476 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 476 comes just before 477!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 496?
quests.hint: Count from the right: ones first, then tens, then hundreds -- find the ones spot.
quests.explanation: In 496, the digit 6 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 6 comes right after 5!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 401, 381, or 326?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 401, 381, and 326, the number 401 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 401, you get 402!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 306 or 172?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 306 is greater than 172 -- when counting up, 306 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you had 306 apples and found one more, you would have 307 apples!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 25, 35, 45, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 10, so after 45 comes 45 + 10 = 55!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 55, you get 56!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 25, 35, 45, 55, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 10, so after 55 comes 55 + 10 = 65!
quests.funFact: If you had 65 apples and found one more, you would have 66 apples!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "Two Hundred Fifty-Nine" is how we say the number 259 in English, so 259 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: The number 259 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 259, 475, or 309?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 259, 475, and 309, the number 475 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 475 comes right after 474!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the tens place of 460?
quests.hint: Count from the right: ones first, then tens, then hundreds -- find the tens spot.
quests.explanation: In 460, the digit 6 sits in the tens place!
quests.funFact: The number 6 is an even number!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 432, 157, or 167?
quests.hint: The smallest number is the one you'd reach first while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 432, 157, and 167, the number 157 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: Double 157 is 314! Because 157 + 157 = 314.

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 25, 50, 75, 100, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 25, so after 100 comes 100 + 25 = 125!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 125, you get 126!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 271 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 271 is written in words as "Two Hundred Seventy-One" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: Did you know? The math word 'Two Hundred Seventy-One' is spelled with exactly 20 letters!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 10, 35, 60, 85, __?
quests.hint: Look at how much bigger each number is than the one before it -- that jump stays the same every time.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 25, so after 85 comes 85 + 25 = 110!
quests.funFact: If you had 110 apples and found one more, you would have 111 apples!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 204 or 350?
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 204 is smaller than 350 -- when counting up, 204 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 204 by 10, it becomes 2040!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 25, 35, 45, 55, __?
quests.hint: The pattern counts up by 10 each time. What comes after 55?
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 10, so after 55 comes 55 + 10 = 65!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 65, you get 66!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the hundreds place of 201?
quests.hint: Split 201 into its place-value parts, then find the hundreds part.
quests.explanation: In 201, the digit 2 sits in the hundreds place!
quests.funFact: If you had 2 apples and found one more, you would have 3 apples!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 288, 218, or 244?
quests.hint: The smallest number is the one you'd reach first while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 288, 218, and 244, the number 218 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 218 comes right after 217!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 368 or 367?
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 368 is greater than 367 -- when counting up, 368 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 368 comes just before 369!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the ones place of 475?
quests.hint: Count from the right: ones first, then tens, then hundreds -- find the ones spot.
quests.explanation: In 475, the digit 5 sits in the ones place!
quests.funFact: The number 5 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: What number continues the pattern: 25, 50, 75, __?
quests.hint: Add the same jump size again to the last number in the pattern.
quests.explanation: Each number jumps up by 25, so after 75 comes 75 + 25 = 100!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 100, you get 101!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 404 or 492?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 492 is greater than 404 -- when counting up, 492 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you had 492 apples and found one more, you would have 493 apples!

quests.instruction: What digit is in the hundreds place of 229?
quests.hint: Cover up every digit except the hundreds digit in 229.
quests.explanation: In 229, the digit 2 sits in the hundreds place!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 2 comes just before 3!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 245 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 245 is written in words as "Two Hundred Forty-Five" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: In math, knowing how to read words like 'Two Hundred Forty-Five' is just as important as knowing the digits!
